newsitem.title: USA: Children's Broadcast adds Memphis outlet.
newsitem.headline: Children's Broadcast adds Memphis outlet.

text.p: Children's Broadcasting Corp said Tuesday it signed an affiliation agreement with WNWZ-AM, a radio station in Memphis owned by Flinn Broadcasting Corp.
The company said its Radio AAHS format, targeted to children age 12 and under and their parents, will begin airing on the station February 15.
Children's Broadcasting produces a programming mix of news, music, stories and games on radio stations in eight major U.S. markets.
The company's shares were up 1/8 Tuesday at 6-3/4.
